items.text:
**Accepted — pre-Unity planning criteria and map update at [`62a44f0e8`](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/commit/62a44f0e8).** I found no substantive correction required. Mark the planning contract accepted and keep **UR-01 and UR-04 specified, not yet qualified**. The whole-engine completion decision remains open.

**Capability coverage.** The 100 criteria preserve the full mapped C# scope. They require source-bound implementation and evidence for mandatory mechanics without inventing mechanics to fill source gaps. The ten interaction families organize the required evidence, and each consequential interaction still needs its own ledger entry and branch coverage. Shared runtime witnesses require validated semantic equivalence. Prior module acceptances and their exclusions retain their exact scope. The first Unity integration remains development/TEST_ONLY unless separately promoted. [Completion contract](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/62a44f0e8/docs/unity/PRE_UNITY_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.md)

**Performance qualification.** The six workload shapes and ten timing targets match the agreed draft. The contract pins the inspected reference host, requires meaningful histories at 128, 1,024, and 10,000 committed receipts, and applies the public save target at all three tiers. It defines strict restore through causal validation and publication, verifies continuation separately, and requires all three batches to pass correctness, p95, and maximum for each named case. The populated envelope, exact due-event obligations, separately measured memory diagnostic, and explicit review of source-illegal workloads preserve the agreed boundaries. Exact workload manifests and all performance results remain future qualification evidence. [Operating envelope and protocol](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/62a44f0e8/docs/unity/PRE_UNITY_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.md#performance-and-operating-envelope)

I compared the candidate with `65e6153a8`. All 15 changed paths were documentation or documentation tooling. I verified that all 49 prior workstream records were preserved, including their 120 direct dependencies and original acceptance criteria, and that all 100 unique criterion IDs map to their intended rows. I reproduced both Markdown documents byte-for-byte with the committed render functions and matched the five reported SHA-256 digests for the contract JSON, contract Markdown, source index, map JSON, and map Markdown. I checked that the index lists 281 unique paths with zero unresolved references recorded. I did not independently rehash all underlying Git blobs, resolve each local link, audit the source clauses or LFS payloads, or rerun the full validators. No repository edits, C# builds, gameplay, or benchmarks occurred. [Review packet](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/tree/62a44f0e8/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-17-pre-unity-contract)

**Close only the planning documentation review.** Implementation and the broader goal remain paused. The amended Consecration source/API contract remains held and unstarted.
